## Goal

One sentence: what should be true when this is done.

## Background

Why this matters and how it fits. Link the relevant ADR or doc.

## Allowed scope

Files and modules this task may change. Anything outside needs a new issue.

## Required interfaces

Signatures or protocols that must be honoured, so this composes with the rest.

## Acceptance tests

Specific, checkable. What must pass, and what must now fail that did not before.

- [ ]
- [ ]

## Engineering invariants that apply

Which rules in `AGENTS.md` bear on this work. Be explicit — these are the
constraints that produce silently wrong answers when broken.

## Non-goals

What this task must *not* do, especially adjacent improvements that look
tempting.
